projectDesc.p: The Online Critical Pseudepigrapha (OCP) provides digital critical editions of Jewish and Christian pseudepigrapha with a dynamic, base-text invariant multi-witness apparatus.

editorialDecl.p: Encoded using the TEI P5 textcrit module (Parallel Segmentation method). Variants and witness transcriptions are recorded using <app>, <lem>, and <rdg> elements.

app.lem: Θεόφιλος δὲ ἱστορεῖ Σολομῶνα τὸν βασιλέα πέμψαι τῷ Τυρίων βασιλεῖ εἰκόνα χρυσῆν, ἀνθʼ ἧς ἐκεῖνον περιθεῖναι τῷ ναῷ κίονα χρυσοῦν, ὃν καὶ ἐπικληθῆναι Χρυσοῦν Κίονα. (Alexander Polyhistor ap. Euseb. Praep. Evang. IX.34.19)
app.rdg: Theophilus relates that King Solomon sent to the king of the Tyrians a golden image, in return for which the latter overlaid a pillar for the Temple with gold, which was also named the Golden Pillar. (Alexander Polyhistor ap. Eusebius, Praep. Evang. IX.34.19)
